name: btn-black-shadow
title: Inset Shadow Button
blurb: Inset shadow creates embossed look; text presses down when clicked.
description: A button with layered inset shadows that give it a beveled, embossed appearance. On click, the shadows shift and the text translates down to simulate a physical press.
use_when: A button that should feel tactile and physical, particularly in skeuomorphic designs.
a11y: Native button element with standard keyboard support.
